Everyday rituals

Water & Warmth

Making the most-used corner of the kitchen feel considered.

Illustrative concept

Plan around the everyday.

Start with what happens around the sink: rinsing vegetables, washing pans, setting down a cup. Leave useful surface space nearby and think about where the dishwasher and waste storage belong.

A tap finish can connect the sink area to the rest of the room. Explore it alongside handles and lighting, then confirm the plumbing, care requirements and fitting details with your chosen specification.
